mechanism: Composite CNeuronMASA runs market-observer agent (forecast multimodal bar sequence over NForecast) in parallel with RL actor; controller Transformer-decoder takes RL actions + observer forecast and emits risk-adjusted actions; reverse-normalization layer maps normalized forecasts to raw targets so observer trains on actual future bars via second-input gradient path; RL also penalized for deviation from controller output.
data_needed: HistoryBars×BarDescr multimodal state + AccountDescr; future NForecast×BarDescr targets; replay buffer rewards
why_new_for_mis: Joint neural forecast-of-state sensor fused into action control—MIS can treat observer latent/forecast residual as regime-ahead and risk-pressure features, not just actor policy.
quote: the market-observer agent outputs forecast values of a multimodal time series for the analyzed financial instrument

mechanism: IsVolumeBreakout: current volume > 20-bar average × VOLUME_THRESHOLD (default 1.5); IsPriceBreakout: close breaks 10-bar high/low resistance/support; LSTM(32 hidden) on volume patterns updates each bar; trade only when volume spike + price breakout + LSTM agree; ATR×2 SL / ATR×3 TP.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD, GBPUSD, Gold (XAU); PERIOD_CURRENT; backtests shown
why_new_for_mis: Liquidity-surge sensor gated by structure break and sequence model—MIS can score breakout authenticity via relative volume + LSTM volume-state rather than price alone.
quote: the method particularly searches for volume spikes of 50% or more over the normal trading volume during a 20-period lookback window

mechanism: Dynamic SL/TP from ATR multipliers; article notes volume threshold and LSTM hidden size should scale with instrument liquidity/volatility personality; suggests self-calibrating params from each symbol’s volume profile and volatility history.
data_needed: ATR handle; SL_ATR_MULTIPLIER; TP_ATR_MULTIPLIER; per-symbol volume profile
why_new_for_mis: Volatility-adaptive breakout risk envelope tied to liquidity personality—MIS can expose ATR-scaled breakout confidence bands per instrument.
quote: ATR-based position sizing also offers organic market adaption. The SL_ATR_MULTIPLIER and TP_ATR_MULTIPLIER dynamic stops and targets dynamically adapt to the volatility profile of each instrument.

mechanism: Multiple directional-change / PLR filters with distinct min_step thresholds run in parallel (PLRMultiAgents OpenCL 3D kernel); each agent extracts piecewise-linear trend segments (slope, intercept, normalized length) at a different volatility granularity; agents + raw series concatenated so ensemble tracks regime shifts from multiple perspectives.
data_needed: Multimodal price tensor N×M×Tw; vector of min_distance thresholds; PLR extrema flags
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Portfolio assets in MASAAT paper; MQL5 continuation EURUSD H1 in final part
why_new_for_mis: Explicit multi-scale trend-regime sensor bank—MIS can maintain parallel PLR-state channels as coarse-to-fine regime descriptors.
quote: By applying directional movement filters with different thresholds to capture significant price changes, the agents first extract trend features from raw time series. This allows them to track market regime shifts from multiple perspectives.

mechanism: CSA tokens = per-asset features over MT_w; TA tokens = per-time-point over NM; Self-Attention encoders yield O_CSA and O_TA; spatio-temporal block builds asset×time attention embeddings; Softmax-normalized portfolio weights per agent then ensemble-fused.
data_needed: P and P_DC tensors; embedding dim D; Transformer CSA/TA encoders
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Multi-asset portfolio setting; EURUSD H1 in implementation tests (16631)
why_new_for_mis: Separates cross-sectional vs temporal correlation sensing—MIS can expose asset-similarity and time-similarity attention maps as live dependency sensors.
quote: sequence tokens in the CSA module are based on individual asset features, optimizing attention embeddings across assets, while tokens in the TA module are based on individual time points, capturing relevance between current and past observations.

mechanism: CNeuronMASAAT concatenates transposed raw series with multi-agent PLR; CSA+TA run on shared concat; CNeuronPortfolioGenerator fuses CSA×TA via MatMul+Softmax attention then projects to latent state for Actor; geometric-progression thresholds (0.01,0.02,0.04) for 3 PLR agents +1 raw agent.
data_needed: BarDescr window; HistoryBars; min_distance vector; LatentCount projection
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train 2023; test Jan 2024; 16 trades
why_new_for_mis: Ensemble fusion of multi-granularity trend views into one market-state embedding—MIS change sensor when agent proposals diverge under volatility.
quote: Even if a single agent misinterprets market trends and produces biased recommendations, the MASAAT framework, through its multi-agent integration, can adaptively refine the final portfolio

mechanism: adaptive_risk_limits: recent_vol/long_term_vol over window (60) scales base_var_limit by sqrt(vol_ratio), capped at 1.5× base; VaR used as soft constraint/penalty inside Markowitz optimization; Monte Carlo VaR with return autocorrelation for FX.
data_needed: Log returns panel; rolling std window; confidence_level; shrinkage cov
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Multi FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD, AUDUSD, crosses, exotics); daily-ish returns; backtest 2000–2024
why_new_for_mis: Portfolio-level volatility regime sensor that directly retunes risk budget—MIS can publish adaptive VaR ceilings as systemic risk state.

mechanism: PortfolioRiskManager.check_correlations flags pairs with |corr|>max_correlation (0.7) when both have positive weight; stress_test multiplies returns by vol_multiplier∈[1.5,3] plus shocks; monitor_volatility reduces exposure when current_vol > historical×threshold.
data_needed: Returns_df; position weights; corr matrix; stress scenarios
why_new_for_mis: Cross-pair correlation breach as liquidity/contagion sensor—MIS can flag synchronized EUR-driven exposure clusters before margin stress.

mechanism: Features: relative_volume=tick_vol/SMA20; volume_volatility_ratio=std5/std20; volume_density=vol/(high−low); buy vs sell volume imbalance=(buy−sell)/(buy+sell); volume clusters via qcut price levels; RandomForest on volume+price features predicts direction; price_velocity=Δclose/Δt.
data_needed: H1 bars n≈2000; tick_volume; RSI/MACD/BB features; RF 400 trees
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Multi FX pairs; M1 history init; H1 volume model; async multi-pair
why_new_for_mis: Microstructure liquidity sensors (density, imbalance, short/long vol-of-volume)—MIS can detect abnormal participation before price trends.
quote: before strong movements, short-term volume volatility often begins to grow faster than long-term volatility. This indicator has become one of the key ones in identifying potential entry points.

mechanism: ArbitrageModule computes synthetic fair price via USD cross rates (handling inverse CAD/CHF/JPY quotes); compares to traded mid; deviations between real and synthetic often precede large moves; tick windows ~1000.
data_needed: 25+ ECN symbols; usd_pairs map; copy_ticks; fair vs market mid
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: AUDUSD, EURUSD, GBPJPY, NZDCHF, etc. ECN suffixes; tick-level
why_new_for_mis: Cross-market dislocation sensor—MIS can treat synthetic−spot gap as FX microstructure stress/lead indicator.
quote: discrepancies between the real and synthetic price often appear before significant market movements.

mechanism: Three DMH-Attn Transformer branches: (1) cross-asset relation—mask ≤50% features, reconstruct from cov+visible; (2) short-term next-bar return coefficients; (3) long-term discounted multi-bar change coefficients; cascade attention fuses long(Query)×short then × relate(Key/Value) into unified state St for Actor–Critic; Critic gradients fine-tune encoders.
data_needed: HistoryBars×BarDescr; MACD/RSI/SMA-style features; NForecast; replay states
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train 2023; test Jan 2024; paper also multi-stock datasets
why_new_for_mis: Denoising predictive-coding state with explicit short/long/relation channels—MIS can read branch latents as multi-horizon market sensors.
quote: StockFormer leverages self-supervised learning to extract hidden patterns from noisy market data. This allows the model to capture short- and long-term dynamics as well as cross-asset dependencies.

mechanism: Relation Encoder Dropout p=0.5 masks inputs; Decoder reconstructs full multimodal series via Cross-DMHAttention; at policy time only Encoder runs—output treated as denoised environment tensor where outliers are replaced by statistics from other univariate series; fused with long/short forecasts.
data_needed: Raw multimodal state; RelateEncoder without decoder at inference
why_new_for_mis: Self-supervised denoising as live regime cleanliness sensor—MIS can use reconstruction error / encoder residual as noise-regime flag.
quote: the Encoder output is a denoised tensor of the environment state, as outliers that do not fit the model's expectations are compensated by statistical values derived from other sequences.

mechanism: CNeuronDecouplingFlow: transpose multimodal series then Legendre wavelet convolution with doubled filters—low-frequency filters plus high-frequency = (−1)^i×low; static normalized wavelets; low stream = long-term trends, high = short-term bursts/anomalies; dual-frequency spatiotemporal encoder routes low→temporal attention, high→dilated causal conv (+S3 shuffle).
data_needed: OHLCV/price-volume factor tensor; wavelet window (≤24 on H1); filters count
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Stock selection setting in paper; MQL5 H1 EURUSD in final part
why_new_for_mis: Frequency-domain regime split (trend vs shock)—MIS can maintain parallel low/high-frequency state channels without Fourier phase loss.
quote: The low-frequency component represents long-term trends, while the high-frequency component captures short-term fluctuations and sharp events.

mechanism: Dual-frequency fusion decoder: Self-Attention on low-freq graph embeddings + Cross-Attention injecting high-freq; sum+normalize; projection MLP; multitask heads for return regression and trend-direction classification; NAFS graph smoothing + learnable PE replace heavier Struct2Vec; tested EURUSD H1 PF≈1.45.
data_needed: Decoupled low/high tensors; Aspa/Atem or PE; FC1 reg / FC2 cla targets
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train 2023; test Jan 2024; 19 trades
why_new_for_mis: Joint return+trend multitask sensor from fused frequency streams—MIS change detector when classification and regression heads disagree.
quote: These layers enable the model to perform multiple tasks simultaneously: forecasting asset returns, estimating trend change probabilities

mechanism: CNeuronMemory: same raw state into LSTM and Mamba recurrent layers (architecturally different forgetting rates) then relative cross-attention reconciles layers; FinMem object runs two memories on bar-wise and transposed univariate projections, cross-fuses, then cross-attends to account P&L/timestamp; prior actions recurrently compared to outcomes.
data_needed: HistoryBars×BarDescr; AccountDescr; nactions; clear memory on trajectory change
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD-style H1 RL setup continued in final part
why_new_for_mis: Explicit multi-timescale memory decay as sensing substrate—MIS can read LSTM vs Mamba disagreement as short-vs-long event salience.
quote: To emulate different forgetting rates, we employed distinct architectures of recurrent blocks for separate memory layers, each inherently possessing different decay characteristics due to its architectural design.

mechanism: feedForward builds account vector from prior equity + profit≈(close−open)/point×(buyVol−sellVol) of last agent action; cActionToAccount cross-attends previous action tensor (held in output buffer) to account state; training looks ahead NForecast to craft ideal action labels from cumulated forecast path—working memory links actions to realized P&L.
data_needed: Prior Actor results; account balance/equity; future state matrix for targets
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 FinMem Study.mq5 training loop
why_new_for_mis: Closed-loop sensor of how recent actions mapped to P&L under current market—MIS can track policy–outcome coupling as adaptive state, not just prices.
quote: the model compares the Agent's most recent actions with the corresponding profits and losses to determine their interdependencies
